head: 6d09a01d3f715f69de82a1069d3f181b42145ada
words: The adapter now reads the fact_transactions partitions from the window's first day through the 14th trading day after its last day (LATE_WINDOW_TRADING_DAYS = 14, with shift_trading_days and transaction_partitions) and counts each TransactionID once: the later partition's copy replaces an earlier one, and a row with no id is kept as its own row. presence_hold keeps the own-partition rule and adds that a day with no partition of its own is present when a row dated it exists in the partitions through the late window. The handler adds settle_days (the landed day 14 trading days back, at or after the floor, not itself owed); a scheduled fire rewrites each such day through the existing rewrite path after the owed days and the transaction stage, and a settle failure is recorded under settle_failed and never raises. The live read-only check of 2026-07-24 found 277 distinct TransactionIDs with a flow on the day; the raw sum would have inflated 30 of the 880 accounts compared, and the deduplicated derivation equals the independent deduplicated sum on all 880. Not proven: nothing is deployed or pushed, the gold is not rewritten, the 49 Financial and Inflection derivations are untouched, and checker clause DBC199-1-AC1 still FAILS on the dirty portal submodule of this worktree (surprise row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W259-S1), so the order stays open. The code commit is fa48b9d8b7.
